posts.text: Are corporations receiving favoritism after donating to Trump? The Trump Administration has dismissed or paused ongoing investigations against large companies that donated to the Trump/Vance inauguration.  Records show that at least 17 companies that donated to Trump saw their investigations or enforcement actions withdrawn or paused after donations as high as $2 million dollars, raising concerns of pay-to-play influence in the White House.

A Texas judge ordered the Texas Workforce Commission and the State of Texas to honor the agreement made with the builders of an Islamic-centric community called The Meadows (EPIC City).  The court ordered the TWC to review the documents and either approve them or reject them with a detailed justification on the reasons.  Fact checking @Patriotic Peach

Most Americans are very worried about the U.S. economy. The majority says that our economy is bad or terrible.  But there are people like @Jack who think that economically disadvantaged Americans don’t have a right to complain because the poor economy does not affect them.  Let’s fact check that.

Food is a human right. Food security should be a right enshrined in the U.S. Constitution, but it’s not.  And some people, including @Mackenzie , share the argument that “we can’t have food as a human right because it forces others to work for free”. That’s not at all what that means.  #foodsecurity #hunger #humanrights

The Supreme Court issued an emergency order blocking a band by the fifth circuit court of appeals on mail order shipments of a specific medication.  The Supreme Court order is only temporary and will last for a week, during which time both parties will have to submit more information.

President Trump brags about handling math in cognitive test.  During a speech, Donald Trump told his audience the story of a cognitive test that he was administered that contained very difficult math problems, which he alone apparently aced.  this is the same president Trump, who said that he lowered prices by 600%.

President Tump announced that his face will be featured in thousands of newly issued U.S. passports, in a move that is unprecedented.  But people like @themeghanelinor argue that US presidents already appear on paper currency.  There’s only one small difference: they were all out there by someone else decades later.

Did Senator Elizabeth Warren, cause spirit airlines to go out of business? Many people, including Cathytalk are saying that it is because of Elizabeth Warren that spirit Airlines could not merge with JetBlue and was forced to go out of business on May 2, 2026. But that’s not how mergers work under United States Federal law.  It was a judge who rejected the merger

During an official state visit by the British Royal family, the Trump administration organized a ceremony where the Bristish flag, the Union Jack, was presented up upside down. This is not the only breach of protocol by the Trump administration during the royal visit, but it is another indication of the chaos that exists in the administration.
